study_identification_part.si4_title: Multimodal normative modeling in Alzheimer's Disease with introspective variational autoencoders

cm1_research_objectives.reason: The abstract and introduction clearly state the aims: to develop a multimodal introspective VAE for normative modeling that better models healthy control distributions, improves multimodal aggregation via MOPOE, and enhances detection of individual deviations for Alzheimer's disease. This directly articulates the study's objectives and the purpose of applying normative modeling (detect deviations/outliers, interpret abnormalities). All criteria are satisfied.
cm1_research_objectives.supporting_text: "Normative models in neuroimaging learn patterns of healthy brain distributions to identify deviations in disease subjects..." | "we developed a multimodal introspective VAE... [and] implemented a Mixture-of-Product-of-Experts (MOPOE) approach... improve abnormality detection..." | "Our first objective was to evaluate whether the introspective VAE (mmSIVAE) achieved better reconstruction performance for cognitively unimpaired healthy controls compared to a standard vanilla VAE."
cm1_research_objectives.location: Kumar2024.pdf.md: Abstract; 5.1 Reconstruction of healthy controls

nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.reason: NEW model using ADNI healthy controls. Eligibility criteria are described (CU with CDR=0 and no amyloid pathology) and the final sample size (N=248) is reported. However, explicit image quality/data completeness standards and reasons for exclusion are not described for the reference cohort.
nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.supporting_text: "For training, we selected 248 cognitively unimpaired (healthy control) subjects from the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging (ADNI) dataset... with Clinical Dementia Rating (CDR) = 0 and no amyloid pathology."

nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.reason: Age and sex are explicitly modeled as covariates. ADNI is multi-site, but the manuscript does not describe handling site effects (e.g., site covariate, ComBat, hierarchical modeling). Thus, only part of the criteria is satisfied.
nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.supporting_text: "We conditioned our model on the age and sex of patients, represented as one-hot encoding vectors, to remove the effects of covariates from the MRI and PET features."

nm3_data_sources_reference_cohort.reason: The data source for the reference cohort is specified as the ADNI dataset, with the foundational reference cited (Mueller et al., 2005).
nm3_data_sources_reference_cohort.supporting_text: "from the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging (ADNI) dataset Mueller et al., 2005"

nm4_image_acquisition_protocol.reason: SECONDARY data are used for the reference cohort (ADNI). Per guidance, image acquisition protocol is not applicable for secondary datasets in this item.

nm5_data_preprocessing.reason: The manuscript describes feature extraction at the ROI level (Desikan–Killiany atlas) for MRI volumes and amyloid PET SUVRs, and normalization of ROIs. It refers to Appendix B for ADNI acquisition/preprocessing, but does not list the specific software versions or detailed QC procedures for ADNI within the main text. Therefore, preprocessing is mentioned but not fully specified.
nm5_data_preprocessing.supporting_text: "Both brain volumes and SUVR values were extracted from 66 cortical (Desikan-Killiany atlas) and 24 subcortical regions." | "Each brain ROI was normalised by removing the mean and dividing by the standard deviation of the healthy control cohort brain regions." | "Details about ADNI data acquisition and preprocessing for T1-weighted MRI and amyloid AV45-PET are provided in Appendix B."

nm6_internal_data_validation_reference_c.reason: A separate holdout set of 48 healthy controls is used for evaluation, distinct from the 248 CU training controls. This satisfies data partitioning for internal validation.
nm6_internal_data_validation_reference_c.supporting_text: "For model evaluation, we used 48 healthy controls for a separate holdout cohort..."

nm7_external_data_validation_reference_c.reason: There is no description of applying the normative model to an independent external dataset of healthy individuals separate from ADNI. The additional dataset (Knight ADRC) is used for ADS (disease) analyses, not for external validation on healthy controls.
nm7_external_data_validation_reference_c.supporting_text: "For model evaluation, we used 48 healthy controls for a separate holdout cohort and a disease cohort of 726 amyloid positive AD spectrum (ADS) individuals..."

Software and libraries (PyTorch; Multi-view-AE for baselines) are specified.
